values.what-went-well: The pairs practical on reaction rates: almost every group got a result they could plot.
values.what-didnt: The explanation at the start ran long, so the write-up was rushed in the last ten minutes.
values.next-time: Put the method on the board before they come in, and keep my introduction to five minutes.

values.feedback: Questioning was strong in the first half. Fewer students answered later on, when the questions were all to the whole class.
action-items: [ ] Try think, pair, share before whole-class questions
[ ] Ask him to observe again in four weeks
